facts.text: Morris Township was named for Lewis Morris, who served as the colonial governor of New Jersey.
The Morristown National Historical Park in Morris Township became the first National Historical Park in the country in 1933.
Morris Township is home to the Morris Museum, which has been in operation since 1913 and is the second largest museum in New Jersey.
Founded in 1894, the Morris County Golf Club was unique for being established and operated by women.
Fosterfields Living Historical Farm in Morris Township has been a state protected living history park and museum since 1972.
Morris Township completely surrounds the town of Morristown, acting as a doughnut around it with at least five times the area.
